items.bm: Log masuk menggunakan MyDigital ID kini tersedia sebagai pilihan kedua di samping log masuk OneID biasa.
items.en_draft: Sign in with MyDigital ID is now available as a second option alongside the standard OneID login.

items.bm: Hanya pengguna yang mempunyai akaun OneID aktif dibenarkan masuk; pengguna lain menerima mesej penolakan yang jelas tanpa akaun baharu dicipta.
items.en_draft: Only users with an active OneID account may sign in; other users receive a clear rejection message and no new account is created.

items.bm: Pengguna boleh mencuba akaun MyDigital ID yang lain, dan proses log keluar kini turut menamatkan sesi MyDigital ID.
items.en_draft: Users can try a different MyDigital ID account, and signing out now also ends the MyDigital ID session.

items.bm: Paparan log masuk, mesej BM/English, rekod aktiviti dan perlindungan maklumat log masuk telah dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: The login screen, BM/English messages, activity records and protection of sign-in information have been improved.

items.bm: Pilihan Bahasa Melayu dan English diperluas pada halaman utama pengguna dan pentadbir.
items.en_draft: Bahasa Melayu and English options were expanded across the main user and administrator pages.

items.bm: Terjemahan, panduan dan mesej sistem diseragamkan supaya lebih jelas dan konsisten.
items.en_draft: Translations, guidance and system messages were standardised for greater clarity and consistency.

items.bm: Proses penyelarasan pengguna ODL dilengkapkan dan paparan Sync User dipermudah untuk kegunaan pentadbir.
items.en_draft: The ODL user synchronisation process was completed and the Sync User screen was simplified for administrators.

items.bm: Keselamatan log masuk pentadbir dan pengesahan tambahan telah diperkukuh.
items.en_draft: Administrator login security and additional verification were strengthened.

items.bm: Sokongan dwibahasa BM/English diperkenalkan secara berperingkat dalam OneID.
items.en_draft: BM/English bilingual support was introduced progressively across OneID.

items.bm: Pengurusan sesi dan paparan aktiviti pengguna ditambah baik untuk kawalan yang lebih jelas.
items.en_draft: Session management and user activity displays were improved for clearer control.

items.bm: Aliran pemulihan akaun dan kata laluan diperkemas untuk membantu pengguna menyelesaikan masalah log masuk.
items.en_draft: Account and password recovery flows were streamlined to help users resolve login issues.

items.bm: Mesej dan panduan keselamatan akaun diperjelas.
items.en_draft: Account security messages and guidance were clarified.

items.bm: Pengurusan kata laluan dan perlindungan akaun pengguna dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: Password management and user account protection were improved.

items.bm: Ciri keselamatan akaun baharu diperkenalkan tanpa mengubah akses pengguna sedia ada.
items.en_draft: New account security features were introduced without changing existing user access.

items.bm: Paparan dan rekod konfigurasi sistem diperkemas untuk pentadbir.
items.en_draft: System configuration screens and records were streamlined for administrators.

items.bm: Kawalan perubahan konfigurasi dipertingkatkan bagi mengurangkan kesilapan operasi.
items.en_draft: Configuration change controls were improved to reduce operational errors.

items.bm: Maklumat aplikasi dan pautan akses dipaparkan dengan lebih teratur.
items.en_draft: Application information and access links were presented more clearly.

items.bm: Pemeriksaan akses aplikasi diperketatkan dan mesej kegagalan diperjelas.
items.en_draft: Application access checks were tightened and failure messages were clarified.

items.bm: Pengurusan aplikasi dan kumpulan akses ditambah baik untuk pentadbir.
items.en_draft: Application and access-group management were improved for administrators.

items.bm: Paparan audit dipermudah supaya aktiviti penting lebih mudah disemak.
items.en_draft: Audit screens were simplified so important activity is easier to review.

items.bm: Carian dan penapisan rekod pentadbir dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: Administrator record search and filtering were improved.

items.bm: Rekod tindakan pentadbir dilengkapkan untuk rujukan dan semakan.
items.en_draft: Administrator action records were expanded for reference and review.

items.bm: Mesej status dan ralat pentadbir dijadikan lebih konsisten.
items.en_draft: Administrator status and error messages were made more consistent.

items.bm: Modul audit pentadbir diperkenalkan untuk memudahkan pemantauan aktiviti.
items.en_draft: An administrator audit module was introduced to make activity monitoring easier.

items.bm: Proses penyelarasan pengguna diperiksa semula bagi meningkatkan ketepatan data.
items.en_draft: User synchronisation was reviewed to improve data accuracy.

items.bm: Ringkasan keputusan penyelarasan pengguna dipaparkan dengan lebih jelas.
items.en_draft: User synchronisation results were presented more clearly.

items.bm: Kawalan penyelarasan pengguna diperketatkan untuk mengelakkan perubahan tidak sengaja.
items.en_draft: User synchronisation controls were tightened to prevent unintended changes.

items.bm: Paparan pratonton penyelarasan pengguna ditambah baik sebelum perubahan disahkan.
items.en_draft: User synchronisation previews were improved before changes are confirmed.

items.bm: Aliran penyelarasan akaun pengguna diperkenalkan dengan semakan sebelum pelaksanaan.
items.en_draft: A user account synchronisation flow was introduced with review before execution.

items.bm: Pengurusan kategori dan status pengguna diperkemas.
items.en_draft: User category and status management were streamlined.

items.bm: Paparan senarai pengguna dan maklumat akaun ditambah baik.
items.en_draft: User lists and account information displays were improved.

items.bm: Kawalan akses pengguna dan aplikasi diperkukuh.
items.en_draft: User and application access controls were strengthened.

items.bm: Pengurusan sesi log masuk dan maklumat peranti ditambah baik.
items.en_draft: Login session management and device information were improved.

items.bm: Asas keselamatan sesi dan pemantauan log masuk diperkenalkan.
items.en_draft: Session security and login monitoring foundations were introduced.

items.bm: Keselamatan log masuk dan kawalan percubaan berulang dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: Login security and repeated-attempt controls were improved.

items.bm: Proses log masuk dan log keluar distabilkan untuk pengalaman yang lebih konsisten.
items.en_draft: Sign-in and sign-out flows were stabilised for a more consistent experience.

items.bm: Paparan versi, maklumat peranti dan sesi pengguna ditambah baik.
items.en_draft: Version display, device information and user sessions were improved.

items.bm: Susun atur dashboard dan navigasi utama dikemas kini.
items.en_draft: The dashboard layout and main navigation were refreshed.

items.bm: OneID menerima kemas kini utama pada rupa, navigasi dan pengurusan akses.
items.en_draft: OneID received a major update to its appearance, navigation and access management.

items.bm: Kestabilan sistem dan pengalaman log masuk ditambah baik.
items.en_draft: System stability and the login experience were improved.

items.bm: Pembetulan kecil dibuat pada paparan dan fungsi harian.
items.en_draft: Minor fixes were made to everyday screens and functions.

items.bm: Paparan aplikasi dan kemudahan penggunaan dipertingkatkan.
items.en_draft: Application screens and ease of use were improved.

items.bm: Versi awal OneID menyediakan log masuk berpusat dan akses kepada aplikasi UPNM.
items.en_draft: The initial OneID release provided central sign-in and access to UPNM applications.
